mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and increases liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When the monthly change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 0.3%, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls by more than 100k in the prior month, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 3% annualized), accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) signals the Federal Reserve's impending tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When the regime of late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 3% annualized) is present and CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.3%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of housing starts (HOUST) signals weak demand for residential construction, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1800 (thousands of units), the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals a contraction in the industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO monthly change is below -0.5%, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 0.5% and RSAFS falls > 0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline by more than 0.5% in the prior month, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%) with declining employment (PAYEMS falls > 100k in the prior month), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS falls > 100k in the prior month
failure_condition: When UNRATE is above 5.5% and PAYEMS falls by more than 100k in the prior month, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
